rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for getting by on very little.

example.english: I subsist on a small amount of savings, and it is really not easy.
example.traditional: 靠少少積蓄過活，真係唔容易。
example.jyutping: kaau3 siu2 siu2 zik1 cuk1 gwo3 wut6 zan1 hai6 m4 jung4 ji6

rows.note: Use this when the focus is on depending on a particular income, resource, or means of support.

example.english: They subsist by growing vegetables, so their income is not very stable.
example.traditional: 靠種菜維生，收入唔算穩定。
example.jyutping: kaau3 zung2 coi3 wai4 sang1 sau1 jap6 m4 syun3 wan2 ding6
